queries.To compare auditory learning and cortica: Behavioral training, electrophysiological recordings, and optogenetic manipulations comparing auditory learning and cortical processing in adolescent and adult mice performing pure tone discrimination tasks, including auditory cortex silencing and neural recordings.
queries.To test whether adolescence affects audi: Go/No-Go pure tone auditory discrimination training in adolescent and adult mice, comparing postnatal day 20 to 37 and postnatal day 60 to 77 groups on easy and hard tone frequency discrimination tasks to evaluate adolescent auditory learning.
queries.To define task difficulty, the easy disc: auditory pure tone discrimination task difficulty in adolescent and adult mice using octave and quarter octave frequency separations in a Go/No-Go behavioral learning paradigm with d-prime performance measures
queries.To standardize learning, our experimenta: Standardized auditory discrimination training timeline for adolescent and adult mice performing pure tone Go/No-Go tasks, including a three-day tone association period, one week of easy task training, and one week of simultaneous easy and hard task training.
queries.To characterize initial behavior and ena: Automated home-cage Educage behavioral characterization and head-fixed simultaneous neural recordings during pure tone Go/No-Go auditory discrimination task in adolescent and adult mice
queries.To quantify task performance, we will me: Behavioral performance quantification in mouse auditory pure tone discrimination tasks using signal detection theory d-prime, response bias, hit rate, false alarm rate, and behavioral variability during adolescent and adult learning
queries.To record and compare cortical processin: High-density Neuropixels recordings from dorsal, primary, ventral auditory cortex and temporal association cortex in adolescent and adult mice performing pure tone discrimination, with analysis of infragranular layers 5 and 6 neural responses and learning-related plasticity
queries.To separate age-related effects from lea: Electrophysiological recordings from naive and expert adolescent and adult mice in auditory cortex before and after pure tone discrimination learning to separate age-related from learning-induced plasticity
queries.To assess basic auditory tuning and lear: Passive listening experiments in adolescent and adult mice to characterize auditory cortical frequency tuning and learning-induced plasticity using pure tones from 4 to 40 kHz at multiple sound pressure levels
queries.To quantify neural discriminability, we: single neuron ROC analysis and population linear discriminant analysis for decoding stimulus and choice related auditory cortical activity in mouse auditory discrimination tasks
queries.To establish causal necessity of auditor: optogenetic silencing of auditory cortex using AAV inhibitory opsins and bilateral optical fibers to assess causal necessity for pure tone discrimination task performance with randomized light stimulation in half of trials in adolescent and adult mice
queries.To ensure valid inference, we will use a: linear mixed-effects models with random effects for repeated measurements and co-housed animals in optogenetic auditory cortex silencing experiments with control virus injections, sex and housing counterbalancing, adolescent and adult mouse auditory discrimination learning
